## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change per commit; commit subjects follow
      [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (see
      AGENTS.md's [Commit Conventions](../AGENTS.md#commit-conventions))
- [ ] `stylua .` run, no formatting diffs left
- [ ] `selene .` passes
- [ ] `:checkhealth mars` and `:messages` checked after reloading, no new
      errors/warnings
- [ ] If this adds/changes a plugin: justified against AGENTS.md's
      [Native-First Philosophy](../AGENTS.md#native-first-philosophy)
